page.layout: One column of running text. Printed page number and running head at the top, the catchword "des" at the lower right. Small marginal marks on the right, beside lines 19 to 26. Edge marks on the far left are not printed text.

main_text.p: fanatis ipsorum vulneribus quæ nupero bello Numidico à Mafinissâ acceperant, & cæteroqui ab omnibus rebus ad novum bellum imparati, nec satis inter se concordes, rursum per legatos (nam & paulo ante idem fecerant) Romæ senatum placare quoquo modo, eiqué satisfacere conati sunt. Sed his à senatu responsum, Si[illegible, ~2 letters] Carthaginienses intra dies xxx, dum adhuc in Sicilià consules essent, nobilissimos quosque filiorum suorum numero ccc obsides iis traderent, & in cæteris morem gererent, mansuram Carthaginem liberam, suiquè juris, & agrum, quem tunc habebat, retenturam. Illi responso cogito[illegible, ~2 letters], animis perplexi, cum satis delibesent[?] spe pacis obsides tradiderunt. Quibus acceptis, ac Romam statim trans-missis, consules legatis, qui obsides adduxerant, ut in mandatis secretis habe-bant, dixerunt, cætera Vticæ se exposi-turos. Istuc ubi ventum cum exercitu, jussi sunt iidem Carthaginienses arma quoque omnia cum omnibus belli instrumentis confestim tradere. Et cum ea etiam in castra Romana allata essent tanto numero ut fidem pene res superet, addidit Marcius Censorinus consulum alter: cedite nobis urbe vestra, Carthaginienses, & quocunque libebit, se-

page.notes: Catchword "des" printed at the lower right, not repeated in the text. The line-initial "Si" is set in a larger capital; read as "Si" with some doubt. The word "cogito" is split across a line end with no printed hyphen visible; "delibesent" is likewise split and doubtful, the word probably being "deliberent". The marks in the right margin (beside "bebat", "cogito" and "delibe") are too faint to read; they are shown as illegible notes. Edge marks on the left and the mark beside "fent" are not text. Printing errors left as printed: "legatis," with a stray mark after it.
